name: Chambal Breweries & Distilleries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Chambal Breweries & Distilleries Ltd is into trading and retailing of IMFL and beer[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CBDL operates in the trading and retailing sectors of Indian Made Foreign Liquor and 
 beer. It markets its products throughout the country through wholesalers and retailers. Company had the sole selling rights for
 IMFL beer and liquor of six companies.

cons: Stock is trading at 16.5 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.23% over last 3 years.
